patterns.title: Agentic operations workflow
patterns.tagline: Several specialists, one budget, one approval gate, one record of what happened.
patterns.summary: A durable workflow coordinates specialist agents through a multi-day business process such as a purchase request: gather quotes, check policy, analyse cost, request approval, then create the order exactly once. Coordination is used only where it measurably beats a single agent.
patterns.customer_job: Move a purchase request from intake to approved order without chasing five people and three systems.
patterns.baseline: Requests sit in email threads; buyers collect quotes by hand, policy checks happen late, and approvers see incomplete context.
patterns.accepted_result: An approved order created once, with quotes, policy checks and the approver's decision attached to the request record.

primary_metric.name: Cycle time to approved order
primary_metric.definition: Median hours from request intake to order created, for requests completed without rework.

economics.basis: Illustrative assumption for a central procurement team. A4 must show it beats an A2 workflow on the same cases before this case holds.

patterns.tagline: Invoices, claims and forms become validated records. Exceptions reach a person with the reason attached.
patterns.summary: Incoming documents are parsed, extracted to a typed schema, validated against master data and business rules, and posted to the system of record exactly once. Anything that fails validation goes to an exception queue with the failing field and evidence.

patterns.tagline: Answers that cite the exact passage, or say they cannot.
patterns.summary: Analysts ask questions of a governed corpus and receive answers in which every claim links to a retrieved passage the asker is allowed to read. Unsupported questions are refused, not guessed.
patterns.customer_job: Find a defensible answer in policies, research reports and filings without reading forty documents.
patterns.baseline: Analysts search shared drives and intranet pages, read in full, and paste excerpts into notes; answers vary by analyst and sources are rarely recorded.
patterns.accepted_result: An answer the analyst forwards without rework, with each claim traceable to a passage they are permitted to see.

journey.title: Ask under your own identity
journey.narration: The analyst signs in once. The workspace sends the question with a scope token derived from their groups.

journey.title: Retrieve only what they may read
journey.narration: The API filters the index by the caller's permissions before ranking. A passage the analyst cannot open never reaches the model.

journey.title: Write from passages, not memory
journey.narration: The gateway routes a prompt that contains only retrieved passages. The model must return a passage ID for every claim.

journey.title: Answer, or refuse plainly
journey.narration: Claims without a passage are removed. If nothing survives, the workspace shows a refusal with the closest documents to read.

journey.title: Keep the corpus current
journey.narration: A changed document is re-parsed and re-indexed with its permissions. Answers that cited the old version are marked for review.

journey.title: Prove it on every release
journey.narration: The harness replays frozen questions and must-refuse cases. Cost and latency are read from gateway telemetry, not estimated.

patterns.title: Support resolution agent
patterns.tagline: Resolves what it is allowed to resolve. Hands off the rest with the case already written.
patterns.summary: A bounded agent answers customer contacts, looks up orders and accounts through typed tools, performs low-risk actions within a written authority, and transfers everything else to a human with a complete case summary.
patterns.customer_job: Get an order, refund or account problem solved in one contact, at any hour.
patterns.baseline: Customers wait in a queue; tier-one agents re-ask the same questions and copy data between the help desk, order system and payment console.
patterns.accepted_result: The contact closes without a reopen within 7 days, or reaches a human who does not need to ask the customer again.

primary_metric.definition: Contacts closed by the agent with no reopen in 7 days, divided by eligible contacts.

journey.title: Contact and verify
journey.narration: The message passes bot checks. The API verifies the customer against the order email before any personal data is read.

journey.title: Plan inside an authority table
journey.narration: The agent receives the case and a written table of what it may do. It reads the return policy before proposing anything.

journey.title: Act with typed tools
journey.narration: Order lookup is a read. A refund up to EUR 50 is a capped write with an idempotency key, so a retry cannot pay twice.

journey.title: Hand off with the case written
journey.narration: Above the cap, or after two failed steps, the agent transfers to a person with a summary, evidence and a suggested action.

journey.title: Confirm and close
journey.narration: The customer sees what was done and what happens next. A reopen within 7 days counts against the agent, not for it.

journey.title: Rehearse before every release
journey.narration: Simulated customers replay known cases. A forbidden action or a duplicate effect fails the release.
